validate-input.objective: A practice roadmap for learning request validation and separating business rules from HTTP.

challenge.instructions: Design a POST /greetings endpoint that accepts a non-empty name and returns a greeting. Describe how invalid requests are handled.

criteria.description: Accept a non-empty string name and reject missing, empty or non-string values.
Return HTTP 400 for invalid input without exposing internal details.
Return a greeting containing the validated name.

separate-rules.objective: A practice roadmap for learning request validation and separating business rules from HTTP.

challenge.instructions: Extract greeting construction into a pure function and keep request validation at the HTTP boundary.

criteria.description: Build greetings without HTTP dependencies or side effects.
Keep validation and status codes at the HTTP boundary.

repository-port.objective: Practice statically verifiable architectural boundaries and safe startup configuration.

challenge.instructions: Implement a Python domain service that loads a name through an injected repository Protocol or ABC. Put a working SQL or in-memory adapter in another module and keep database libraries out of the domain.

criteria.description: The domain service receives a repository typed as a Protocol or ABC and calls its declared lookup method instead of constructing a concrete adapter.
A concrete SQL or in-memory adapter in another module implements the repository lookup signature and returns the stored name or None when absent.
The domain module imports no database library, directly or through a concrete adapter import.

config-validation.objective: Practice statically verifiable architectural boundaries and safe startup configuration.

challenge.instructions: Build a TypeScript application that reads PORT and API_TOKEN from environment variables once at module startup into a shared typed configuration object. Require PORT to be an integer from 1 to 65535 and API_TOKEN to be a non-blank string. Stop startup with a clear error for missing or invalid values, without logging secrets.

criteria.description: Read environment configuration only once at startup into a typed object shared by consumers; do not read it again inside request functions or other modules.
Before startup continues, reject missing, blank, non-numeric, fractional or out-of-range PORT and missing or blank API_TOKEN with an error naming the invalid field.
Never log API_TOKEN, its value, or an object containing it, including in errors.

files.app/sql.py:
import sqlite3
from .domain import Names


class SqlNames(Names):
    def lookup(self, key: str) -> str | None:
        with sqlite3.connect(":memory:") as db:
            db.execute("CREATE TABLE names (id TEXT, name TEXT)")
            row = db.execute("SELECT name FROM names WHERE id = ?", (key,)).fetchone()

        return row[0] if row else None
